dependency_quantification.analysis: The premise verifier is a hybrid system: Stage 1 utilizes generic linguistic and AST-style token parsing (30%) combined with standard domain specifications (React 18 canonical hooks and JS built-in prototypes; 25%). Stage 2 relies on 20 explicit curriculum domain invariant rules (20%). Stage 3 applies corpus evidence retrieval and grounding to verify support/refutation against curriculum text (20%), with vector similarity providing fallback semantic relevance scoring (5%). Therefore, while syntax and prototype methods are dynamically verified, curriculum semantic contradictions are grounded in declared course domain rules and cannot be claimed as 100% unsupervised generic semantic reasoning.
